notes.title: Reset before the next claim
notes.text: A slot that ran work is marked dirty and reset before it claims again. A failed reset keeps the mark and is retried with backoff.

shapes.author: agent
shapes.text: A refusing signal returns refuse and nothing runs. The session lane checks the daemon's socket and uid; when a check fails it never falls back to the console.
